cards.example_en: Within two days the police solved the robbery at the bank.
cards.example_zh: 警察在两天内破获了那起银行抢劫案。

cards.example_en: We did a role-play in which I acted as a shopkeeper.
cards.example_zh: 我们做了角色扮演，我扮演店主。

cards.example_en: A thick root has cracked the path beside the old tree.
cards.example_zh: 一条粗根把老树旁边的小路撑裂了。

cards.example_en: The rough towel felt uncomfortable against my sunburn.
cards.example_zh: 粗糙的毛巾蹭在晒伤处，感觉很不舒服。

cards.example_en: This route avoids the busy junction near the market.
cards.example_zh: 这条路线避开了市场附近拥挤的路口。

cards.example_en: I used a rubber to erase the wrong maths sum.
cards.example_zh: 我用橡皮把算错的那道数学题擦掉了。

cards.example_en: Read the rubric carefully before you start the writing test.
cards.example_zh: 开始写作测验前，请仔细阅读题目说明。

cards.example_en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full of food.
cards.example_zh: 嘴里塞满食物时说话是无礼的。

cards.example_en: They practise rugby on the muddy field behind school.
cards.example_zh: 他们在学校后面泥泞的场地上练习橄榄球。

cards.example_en: They sail across the bay in summer.
cards.example_zh: 夏天他们乘船穿过海湾。

cards.example_en: Her monthly salary covers the rent and the groceries.
cards.example_zh: 她每月的薪水够付租金和买菜的钱。

cards.example_en: Before lunch the children built a sandcastle on the beach.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

cards.example_en: Heat the milk in a saucepan and then add the sugar.
cards.example_zh: 把牛奶放在煮锅里加热，然后再加糖。

cards.example_en: Dad fried a sausage with eggs before leaving for work.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸上班前用鸡蛋配着煎了一根香肠。

cards.example_en: The opening scene shows a rainy street at night.
cards.example_zh: 开场的场景是夜晚一条下雨的街道。

cards.example_en: From the train window, the scenery looked green and peaceful.
cards.example_zh: 从火车窗口望去，风景翠绿而宁静。

cards.example_en: For our drive, we chose a scenic road through the hills.
cards.example_zh: 驾车出行时，我们选了一条穿过山丘的风景优美的路。

cards.example_en: The exam schedule is pinned beside the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 考试日程钉在教室门旁边。

cards.example_en: She won a scholarship to university.
cards.example_zh: 她获得了大学奖学金。

cards.example_en: The scientific method starts with a clear question.
cards.example_zh: 科学方法从提出一个清楚的问题开始。

cards.example_en: Do not scratch the paint on the new desk in your room.
cards.example_zh: 不要刮花你房间里新书桌上的漆。

cards.example_en: The injured player began to scream on the football pitch.
cards.example_zh: 那名受伤的球员在足球场上开始惨叫。

cards.example_en: When the thunder started, the little screamer ran to his mum.
cards.example_zh: 开始打雷时，那个尖叫的小孩跑向了妈妈。

cards.example_en: The drama club reprinted the script with fewer pages.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社重印了剧本，页数比以前少。

cards.example_en: At this harbour restaurant, fresh seafood is the special dish.
cards.example_zh: 在这家港口餐馆，新鲜海鲜是招牌菜。

cards.example_en: Our family spends every August at the seaside with friends.
cards.example_zh: 我们家每年八月都和朋友们在海滨度过。

cards.example_en: The school secretary printed the letters after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 学校秘书午饭后把那些信打印了出来。

cards.example_en: Dad works in the records section of the hospital.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在医院的档案部门工作。

cards.example_en: Seize the chance to speak English.
cards.example_zh: 抓住说英语的机会。

cards.example_en: We select fresh apples at the market on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 星期六我们在市场挑选新鲜的苹果。

cards.example_en: The senior students organised the sports day stalls.
cards.example_zh: 高年级学生组织了运动会的摊位。

cards.example_en: It is sensible to carry water when you hike in summer.
cards.example_zh: 夏天徒步时带上水是明智的。

cards.example_en: She is halfway through a series of mystery novels.
cards.example_zh: 那套推理小说她已经读了一半。

cards.example_en: In the story, the servant opened the gate.
cards.example_zh: 故事里仆人打开了大门。

cards.example_en: From many homes, sewage goes to a new cleaning plant in the city.
cards.example_zh: 许多家庭的污水被送到城里一座新的净化厂。

cards.example_en: The application form asks for age, name, and sex.
cards.example_zh: 申请表上要填写年龄、姓名和性别。

cards.example_en: His shadow stretched across the path.
cards.example_zh: 他的影子拉在小路上。

cards.example_en: That sharp knife belongs in the drawer, away from children.
cards.example_zh: 那把锋利的刀应该放在抽屉里，远离孩子。

cards.example_en: Write your class number at the top of the sheet.
cards.example_zh: 把你的班级号写在这张纸的上方。

cards.example_en: They waited in a bus shelter.
cards.example_zh: 他们在公交候车亭里等。

cards.example_en: In less than one hour, the shoemaker repaired both my boots.
cards.example_zh: 不到一个小时，鞋匠就把我的两只靴子修好了。

cards.example_en: With a smile, the shopkeeper gave the child a free apple.
cards.example_zh: 店主微笑着给了孩子一个免费的苹果。

cards.example_en: Waves broke on the shore.
cards.example_zh: 浪花拍在岸上。

cards.example_en: Snow on the rooftops made a lovely sight at dawn.
cards.example_zh: 黎明时分，屋顶上的雪构成一幅可爱的景象。

cards.example_en: Your signature is needed on this form before the school trip.
cards.example_zh: 学校旅行之前，这份表格上需要你的签名。

cards.example_en: Silence filled the exam room.
cards.example_zh: 考场里一片寂静。

cards.example_en: I sincerely thank you for your help.
cards.example_zh: 我真诚地感谢你的帮助。

cards.example_en: The stone will sink in water.
cards.example_zh: 石头会沉入水中。

cards.example_en: Sip the hot tea slowly so you do not burn your tongue.
cards.example_zh: 热茶要慢慢小口喝，以免烫到舌头。

cards.example_en: Workers fenced off the building site beside the gym.
cards.example_zh: 工人们把体育馆旁边的建筑工地围了起来。

word.example_en: It is wrong to be rude to classmates.
